اشتويت (form VIII)
# اِشْتَوَيْتُ (ištawaytu) /iʃ.ta.waj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# اِشْتَوَيْتَ (ištawayta) /iʃ.ta.waj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# اِشْتَوَيْتِ (ištawayti) /iʃ.ta.waj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# اُشْتُوِيتُ (uštuwītu) /uʃ.tu.wiː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
